title: Crispy Vegan Fried Rice
description: A vegan version of the classic Chinese dish, made with fried rice and served as a crispy snack.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped bitter melon and cook until it starts to brown.
Add the cold fried rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the club soda and stir-fry for another minute.
Use a spatula to break up any clumps and separate the rice into individual grains.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
